The arrows in the figure point along the food chain from lower-level organisms to predators or higher-level roles, and finally there are arrows pointing to Hunter at the upper left. Reasoning: The question asks who is the highest in the food chain in the figure. Because Hunter is located at the highest end of the diagram, and the arrows finally point to Hunter, the highest is hunter.
